plan.goal: Create a full block group FIPS column in the population table by concatenating state_fips, county_fips, tract_fips, and block_group_fips.
plan.notes: Zero-pad state_fips to 2 characters, county_fips to 3, tract_fips to 5, and block_group_fips to 1 before concatenation to match standard Census GEOID format used in the vector asset.

plan.goal: Join the processed population table to the block group boundaries vector using the full FIPS identifier.
plan.notes: Perform an attribute join matching the vector GEOID column to the newly created FIPS column in the table. Retain all geometry and population attributes.
